middle: Rarest words bury {drop} in the middle.
walk: Run the alphabet in front of {drop}, out loud. A, then B, then C.
room: Pick a room and stand in it — a kitchen, a hospital, a workshop.
who: Ask who says this word. A chef, a nurse, a driver.
sound: Say it out loud. Don't define it.
second: Skip the first word that comes to mind. It's a common one.
